title: S10 the empty Session tab
can: Add a project (a folder picker; nothing is copied), import existing sessions, or type straight into the composer. The empty state is one line.

title: S10 importing Claude Code and Codex sessions
can: Pick the sessions found on this computer, by project; they come in with their history and continue on a new engine session.

title: S11 / commands in the composer
can: Type / for /model, /side, /clear, /compact and the session's skill and plugin commands; the kit's menu, above the composer, arrows and Enter to pick.

title: S11 @ files and $ skills
can: Type @ to put a worktree file in the message as a chip (R-inline-1); type $ to pick a skill.

title: S12 side chat
can: Ask on the side (/side or /btw) in a tab of the right panel, with its own composer; Add to chat brings an answer into the main thread. The main turn keeps running and its context is untouched.

title: S13 the right panel: Files
can: Browse and search the session's worktree; changed files carry their counts; a file opens read-only or goes into the message as an @ chip.

title: S14 the right panel: Terminal
can: A real shell in the session's worktree, its path and branch in the head, new tabs with +; select output to attach it to the message as a chip.

title: S15 the right panel: PR
can: The session's pull request: title, branch, checks, reviews; open it on GitHub or update it from the session.

title: S16 usage limits and the context tick
can: The composer's line shows the context as dots with its count and the weekly quota; at the limit one notice offers the fallback model or resuming at the reset time.

title: S17 continued after a restart
can: A session running when the app closed continues with one line; its queued message is still queued (the engine's store).

title: S18 error: the engine stopped
can: One line in the thread with one way out: start the engine again.

title: S18 error: no model for this session
can: The launch step names the missing model in its row with Choose a model; nothing starts until one is set.

title: S18 error: the gate failed
can: The turn's gate card says failed in red with the failing check and Fix and retry; nothing was written to the workspace.

title: S19 option A (recommended): Settings > Sessions, the scope as a segmented control
can: Set the defaults for new sessions, how Enter behaves, the blank wait, the work log, and the inbox's settle and restart rules, for this device or this project.

title: S19 option B: the scope as a select beside the title
can: The same page; the scope names the project directly, which scales to several projects but hides that the page has a device level, hence A.

title: S20 the session's details
can: The title pill opens the session's details: change the model, effort or how careful (which makes the S8 line), see the context, cost and the PR; Pin, Fork and Settle are in the overflow.
